surface: SUNNYVAiLE LIBRAiRY / The Breakthroughs That Changed AI

readerContract.humanQuestion: When people call an AI result a breakthrough, what actually changed, how do we know, and what does it not prove?
readerContract.promisedPayoff: The reader can follow the major eras and domains represented in a broad, argued history; explain why named pivotal advances mattered in ordinary language; and test a new breakthrough claim using evidence, consequence and boundary rather than awe.
readerContract.priorKnowledge: No technical background is assumed. AI Fundamentals 101 is useful but not required.
readerContract.centralMentalModel: A real breakthrough removes a prior constraint through a reusable mechanism, produces an observable change, has downstream consequences, and still has a boundary.
readerContract.dailyLifeConnection: The same distinction helps a reader judge a viral demo, a scientific claim, a surprising chatbot answer or a claim that a new product changes everything.
readerContract.surfaceJob: A broad, scannable living history across rules, learning, vision, language, reinforcement learning, generation, assistants, reasoning, robotics and science, with visible selection limits and a watchlist for later editions.
readerContract.desiredFeeling: I understand why these moments mattered, and I know what question to ask when the next one arrives.

glossaryAccumulation.producerGuard: Chapters follow a consequential historical arc, not a term list.
glossaryAccumulation.preventionEvidence: The breakthrough receipt connects every selected moment.

templateRepetition.producerGuard: The receipt governs evidence but does not force identical prose boxes.
templateRepetition.preventionEvidence: Case study, mechanism explainer and scientific boundary use different forms.

decorativeAnalogy.producerGuard: No analogy survives unless it maps a named mechanism and states its limit.
decorativeAnalogy.preventionEvidence: The analogy plan authorises only bounded mappings.

referenceConfetti.producerGuard: A named system appears only when it changes the historical map or exposes an important limit.
referenceConfetti.preventionEvidence: The selection rule and explicit exclusions prevent a parade of famous names.

missingMechanism.producerGuard: Every chapter names the before-state, mechanism and observed change.
missingMechanism.preventionEvidence: The causal sequence and selection rule require mechanism.

genericAction.producerGuard: The reader applies a five-part breakthrough test to a named claim.
genericAction.preventionEvidence: The useful action produces a completed evidence receipt.

jargonBeforeMeaning.producerGuard: Begin every substantial idea with what people could not do, make the causal movement visible, and only then name the method.
jargonBeforeMeaning.preventionEvidence: The four-domain representative proof passed the second false-pass gate before the full successor was built.

disconnectedSystem.producerGuard: Every moment changes one shared map of learn, perceive, generate, plan or predict.
disconnectedSystem.preventionEvidence: The chronology returns to the same breakthrough test.

joylessInstruction.producerGuard: Use story, consequence and earned surprise while preserving exact evidence.
joylessInstruction.preventionEvidence: Human problems span conversation, rules, sight, language, games, generation, weather, materials, proteins and robots.

purposeTooNarrow.producerGuard: A broad title requires named coverage across at least four domains and three eras, explicit exclusions and a living watchlist.
purposeTooNarrow.preventionEvidence: The contents name ten reader routes from early AI through science and future candidates; Move 37 is one chapter, not the title or spine.

mechanismBeforeMotivation.producerGuard: Show the human or scientific obstacle before explaining machinery.
mechanismBeforeMotivation.preventionEvidence: Each era opens with a recognisable task or limit rather than a technical label.

workedExampleOvertakesBookPurpose.producerGuard: No landmark may become the title-level proxy for the whole history.
workedExampleOvertakesBookPurpose.preventionEvidence: The successor title is The Breakthroughs That Changed AI; AlphaGo and AlphaFold receive proportionate chapters within the chronology.

technicalExplainerVoice.producerGuard: Write as an exact, curious guide for capable adults.
technicalExplainerVoice.preventionEvidence: The reader payoff is judgment, not technical coverage.

draftArchitecture.plainAnswer: A breakthrough is not merely an impressive output: it is a reusable mechanism that removes a real constraint, survives an appropriate test and changes what follows, without proving more than the evidence allows.
causalSequence: Explain the reusable mechanism in plain language.
Show the observed result and comparison.
State what the result did not establish.
Apply the same evidence test to a new claim.
draftArchitecture.workedCase: Move 37: trace learned policy and value estimates through focused search, then separate strategic surprise from consciousness or general intelligence claims.
draftArchitecture.transferCase: AlphaFold2: trace sequence and evolutionary evidence to a predicted structure and confidence, then decide which biological claims still require experiments.
draftArchitecture.usefulAction: Complete a breakthrough receipt for one current claim: before, mechanism, observed change, boundary, consequence, and evidence needed for the bigger claim.

analogyPlan.analogy: Trace a bad result backwards through a chain of contributors and adjust each contribution.
analogyPlan.mapping: Output error supplies a signal to update earlier weights.
analogyPlan.limit: A network does not understand blame or intention.
analogyPlan.whyItHelps: It makes credit assignment concrete without personifying the model.

humourPlan.lessonJob: Use light wit to puncture inflated breakthrough mythology; never joke away evidence or scientific limits.

draftArchitecture.formatSpecificStructure: Introduction states the selection rule and six capability domains. The named chronology covers early ideas, rule systems and winters, learned features, vision, language, reward and search, modern assistants, generation, reasoning and tools, robotics and science. Move 37 and AlphaFold are two landmarks among many. The close carries explicit exclusions, a living watchlist and reader-visible primary sources.
draftArchitecture.antiTemplateDecision: Hide the evidence scaffold inside natural narrative. Every chapter opens with a human puzzle, explains one causal chain in ordinary language, names technical terms only after meaning, returns to consequence and uses a teach-back that exposes gaps. Do not repeat visible Before/Mechanism/Boundary cards.

communicationDesign.surfaceAdaptation: Use a living narrative reference: start with a human puzzle, expose the mechanism, then land in evidence and a better question. Never imitate a presenter or Hannah Fry’s voice.

humanQuestion.reason: Breakthrough language is used to demand belief.
humanQuestion.plannedEvidence: Ask how a reader can tell whether a strange result is discovery or error.

usefulCuriosity.plannedEvidence: Let the reader consider how anyone could know the move was good before explaining the answer key.

invisibleProcessConcrete.reason: Learned evaluation and search are hidden.
invisibleProcessConcrete.plannedEvidence: Trace proposal, evaluation, search and result in a visible sequence.

familiarTechnicalMovement.reason: The reader needs mechanism without prerequisites.
familiarTechnicalMovement.plannedEvidence: Move from a board-game decision to policy, value and search, then back to verification.

limitationsConsequences.plannedEvidence: Each major case states the exact result, boundary and downstream consequence.

humourSurprise.reason: A small deflation can make overclaim memorable.
humourSurprise.plannedEvidence: Use earned wit only when rejecting mythology, never as proof.

betterNextQuestion.reason: The book must survive future launches.
betterNextQuestion.plannedEvidence: End with the six-part breakthrough receipt.

explanationArc.sharedStartingPoint: A professional Go player and the audience initially see a machine place a stone where it appears not to belong.
explanationArc.curiosityGap: If the move looked wrong to experts, what made it a breakthrough rather than an error?
mechanismSequence: A policy network proposes promising moves.
A value network estimates the position.
Tree search spends effort on the most useful continuations.
The shared rules and final result provide a hard delayed test.
explanationArc.earnedClick: Surprise becomes evidence only when an appropriate answer key or independent test supports it.
explanationArc.smallLanding: A reader can test the next breakthrough claim without understanding every equation.
explanationArc.safetyBoundary: Do not transfer trust from bounded games or blind scientific assessments to high-stakes open-ended decisions without domain evidence.

representativeProofPlan.highestRisk: A broad-history promise could collapse into AlphaGo and AlphaFold plus compressed jargon.
representativeProofPlan.plannedProof: Before the full successor, prove ordinary-language explanation across perceptron learning, AlphaGo search, assistant mechanisms and AlphaFold science, with separate diagnostic transfer checks.
representativeProofPlan.acceptanceOutcome: An independent cold-reader review passes at least four domains and three eras without requiring unexplained technical vocabulary.
